lines.text: Not long ago, a good video needed a studio, expensive software, and years of practice.
Today, it needs an idea and a few sentences.
A teacher can turn tomorrow's lesson into a video tonight.
A small shop can make its own ads, without an agency.
A creator can publish in English and Hindi from the same project.
When editing becomes language, anyone with something to say can be seen.
That's how vibe editing is changing the world. One sentence at a time.
